newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO up on H.K. MidCap index inclusion.
newsitem.headline: COSCO up on H.K. MidCap index inclusion.

text.p: Shares in China-backed COSCO Pacific Ltd were boosted by overseas buying on Thursday after HSI Services Ltd said the stock was to be included in the Hang Seng MidCap 50 Index, brokers said.
The stock ended up HK$0.30 at HK$6.70 with 12.9 million shares traded.

"Anticipation that the company will attract more attention from overseas investors after joining the index made investors feel comfortable about buying for the long term," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage.
